A '''methane lake''' was a body of liquid [[Methane/Legends|methane]] which could be found on the high-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. The [[Malastare 100/Legends|Malastare 100]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] circuit was built around a methane lake. During Malastare's [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] race, the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[By't Distombe]] crashed while flying over a methane lake, thanks to a methane geyser that sprung from underneath his [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]].
